policy: Do not patch domain locks or rewrite eval/localhost checks to bypass publisher restrictions.
Do not emulate login, online leaderboards, achievements, paid features, ad completion or reward callbacks as if they succeeded.
A permitted offline adapter may expose only observed guest/not-authorized behavior and no-op save/ad callbacks; record the missing service as a limitation.
Keep official publisher players intact where the original runtime is domain-locked or carries source-specific framing/distribution conditions.
